Everything since this savepoint (%s) is undone: blocks, mobs, items and your position. Your world reloads.

The current state is saved first as a "Before revert" savepoint, so you can undo this.
savepoint.settings.title: Savepoint settings
savepoint.setting.storeBudgetGb.desc: The most disk space all savepoints of a world may use together. When it is exceeded the oldest savepoints are deleted automatically, but never pinned ones or the newest few. 0 means unlimited.
savepoint.setting.keepNewest.desc: This many of the newest savepoints are never deleted automatically, even when the disk budget is exceeded.
savepoint.setting.cooldownSeconds.desc: Minimum wait between two savepoints, and between two reverts. Protects against key mashing. Off means no wait.
savepoint.setting.fullBackupMode.desc.of: Never offer a full backup. Savepoints still work normally.
savepoint.setting.fullBackupMode.desc.se: After your first savepoint of each play session, chat offers a button to also write a complete copy of the world as a zip file.
savepoint.setting.fullBackupMode.desc.ev: Write a complete zip of the world in the background after every savepoint. Uses a lot of disk space.
savepoint.setting.fullBackupKeep.desc: How many full backup zips to keep for this world. Older zips are deleted. Zips are stored next to the savepoints and do not count towards the disk budget.
savepoint.hint.keys: Savepoint: %s opens your savepoints, %s takes a quick one, %s reverts to it. (Also on the pause menu.)
savepoint.revert.confirm.lan: Your world is open to LAN: other players will be disconnected and need to rejoin.
